maps.points.mausoleum_3.a01.title: Go upstairs → Cells of the Forgotten
maps.points.mausoleum_3.detail: The stairwell drops into a hall drowned in red. The stone sweats with a sickly glow, seams pulsing like veins beneath the floor.
maps.points.mausoleum_3.detail-3: The chamber beyond the door bears little resemblance to a crypt.
maps.points.mausoleum_3.detail-5: Golden Key of Zerethic, Staff of Fireball, Crimson Ring
maps.points.mausoleum_3.detail-6: Step on the sensor at (10, -4) to trigger Zerics' appearance event.
maps.points.mausoleum_3.dialogue: The stairwell drops into a hall drowned in red. The stone sweats with a sickly glow, seams pulsing like veins beneath the floor.
maps.points.mausoleum_3.dialogue-10: His voice is almost lost beneath the constant bubbling of alchemical flasks and the hiss of boiling liquids.
maps.points.mausoleum_3.dialogue-2: Whatever tainted this place hasn't left. It crawls beneath the surface.
maps.points.mausoleum_3.dialogue-3: Rows of stone coffins stand open, each filled to the brim with thick crimson liquid. Strange tubes, rusted tools, and shattered glass cover tables between them.
maps.points.mausoleum_3.dialogue-4: It looks less like a mausoleum... and more like the laboratory of a mad mage.
maps.points.mausoleum_3.dialogue-5: A hooded figure pauses over one of the coffins, carefully lowering something beneath the blood-red surface.
maps.points.mausoleum_3.dialogue-6: Only then does he look up.
maps.points.mausoleum_3.dialogue-7: His eyes sweep over your weapons, your armor... and finally settle on you.
maps.points.mausoleum_3.dialogue-8: With an irritated sigh, he raises his staff.
maps.points.mausoleum_3.dialogue-9: A sphere of crimson fire blossoms above its tip, growing larger with every heartbeat.
maps.points.mausoleum_3.f02.detail: Search for the red stone coffin at (13, -13).
maps.points.mausoleum_3.l04.detail: Potion of Stamina, Potion of Poison, Wardstone Elixir
maps.points.mausoleum_3.l08.detail: Potion of Frostvein (Recipe), Potion of Minor Mana (Recipe), Whispering Gloves
maps.points.mausoleum_3.title: Enter the red mausoleum
maps.points.mausoleum_3.title-2: Zerics appears for the first time
